name: joints
title: Joints that aren't flexures: a pin joint printed in place, and a snap pin with its socket
orientation: Flat as drawn, the peg standing up. After printing, twist the lever to break it free of the base and the cap; push the peg into the socket until it clicks, and pull it out again (its barb's back is at 45°, so it lets go).

base.label: The base: the pin with its cap, and the socket

lever.label: The lever, on a ring round the pin

clearance.rule: Ring to pin, and socket to peg: the printer's fit

lift.rule: The ring off the base and the cap off the ring: a support gap, to break free

depth.rule: The socket's depth, and the peg's shaft

slot.rule: The split down the peg from its tip: each half a cantilever this long

back.rule: The barb's back: 45° prints standing and lets go; 90 would hold

socket_at.rule: The socket's centre from the pin, along x

peg_at.rule: The peg's centre from the pin, along x: loose beside the socket

overlap.rule: How far the bridge runs into the socket's wall, so they join
